- 只写 stdin 指定的文件。
- 文件路径必须是 `<项目名>-tutorial/<filename>`。
- 不要写其他文件。
- 不要修改源码。
- 完成后，用一句话总结本讲义覆盖了哪些最小模块。

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the task

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task

model.description: Optional model override for this agent. Takes precedence over the agent definition's model frontmatter and the configured default subagent model. If omitted, uses the agent definition's model, else the default (inherits from the parent unless a default subagent model is configured). Ignored for subagent_type: "fork" — forks always inherit the parent model.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this agent. Set this ONLY when the user, or instructions such as CLAUDE.md or a skill, explicitly ask that this agent or delegated work run at a specific effort level, never on your own judgment; otherwise omit it and the agent runs at its usual effort. Ignored for subagent_type: "fork": a fork runs at your own effort.

run_in_background.description: Agents run in the background by default; you will be notified when one completes. Set to false only when your very next action depends on this agent's result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise leave it in the background so the user can hand you other work.

isolation.description: Isolation mode. "worktree" creates a temporary git worktree so the agent works on an isolated copy of the repo. "remote" launches the agent in a remote cloud environment (always runs in background; availability is gated).

tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

timeout.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds (max 600000 for a foreground command)

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

run_in_background.description: Set to true to run this command in the background. With it, `timeout` limits how long the command may run in the background before it is stopped (default 600000 ms, max 7200000 ms).

dangerouslyDisableSandbox.description: Set this to true to dangerously override sandbox mode and run commands without sandboxing.

tools.name: Edit
tools.description:
Performs exact string replacement in a file.

- You must Read the file in this conversation before editing, or the call will fail.
- `old_string` must match the file exactly, including indentation, and be unique — the edit fails otherwise. Strip the Read line prefix (line number + tab) before matching.
- `replace_all: true` replaces every occurrence instead.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to modify

new_string.description: The text to replace it with (must be different from old_string)

replace_all.description: Replace all occurrences of old_string (default false)

tools.name: Glob
tools.description: Fast file pattern matching. Supports glob patterns like "**/*.js" or "src/**/*.ts". Returns matching file paths sorted by modification time.

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match files against

path.description: The directory to search in. If not specified, the current working directory will be used. IMPORTANT: Omit this field to use the default directory. DO NOT enter "undefined" or "null" - simply omit it for the default behavior. Must be a valid directory path if provided.

tools.name: Grep
tools.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

tools.name: ListAgents
tools.description: Lists agents you can SendMessage to — in-process subagents you spawned, the teammates on your team, other local Claude sessions on this machine, your Claude sessions running in the cloud (when this session has cloud access; a cloud session receives your message but cannot message any session back yet — do not ask it to reply, read its answer in its own transcript), and (when Remote Control is connected here) your account's other sessions — Remote Control sessions on other machines and cloud sessions, each row labeled by kind. Names are the address: send with `SendMessage({to: "<name>", message: "..."})`, copying the name exactly as a row prints it. Append a row's ` [ref]` only when the bare name is not enough — two rows share it, or an error asks you to disambiguate.

channel.description: Not available in this build; leave unset.

q.description: Not available in this build; leave unset.

tools.name: Read
tools.description:
Reads a file from the local filesystem.

- `file_path` must be an absolute path.
- Reads up to 2000 lines by default.
- When you already know which part of the file you need, only read that part. This can be important for larger files.
- Results are returned using cat -n format, with line numbers starting at 1
- Reads images (PNG, JPG, …) and presents them visually. Reads PDFs via the `pages` parameter (e.g. "1-5", max 20 pages/request; required for PDFs over 10 pages). Reads Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) as cells with outputs.
- Reading a directory, a missing file, or an empty file returns an error or system reminder rather than content.
- Do NOT re-read a file you just edited to verify — Edit/Write would have errored if the change failed, and the harness tracks file state for you.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to read

offset.description: The line number to start reading from. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once

limit.description: The number of lines to read. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once.

pages.description: Page range for PDF files (e.g., "1-5", "3", "10-20"). Only applicable to PDF files. Maximum 20 pages per request.

allow_large.description: Set to true to read a text file, or a line range of one, that is over the usual size limits, up to what still fits in your context. Only use this when you genuinely need all of it or the user asked for the whole file; otherwise read it in parts with offset and limit, or search it.

tools.name: ReportFindings
tools.description: Report code-review findings as a typed list so the host UI can render them. Use this only when the active code-review instructions tell you to report findings with this tool; otherwise follow whatever output format those instructions specify. When reporting a review's results, call it once with the verified findings ranked most-severe first (empty array if nothing survived verification) and do not also print the findings as text. When re-reporting after applying fixes (only if the apply instructions ask for it), set `outcome` on each finding to what actually happened.

level.description: Effort level the review ran at

findings.description: Verified findings, most-severe first; empty if none survived

file.description: Repo-relative path of the file the finding is in

short_summary.description: Compressed label for compact UI (≤60 chars): the claim alone, no rationale or consequence clause

category.description: Short kebab-case slug of the finding type, e.g. "correctness", "simplification", "efficiency", "test-coverage"

verdict.description: Set when a verify pass ran; absent on inline-only reviews

outcome.description: Set ONLY when re-reporting after applying fixes: what happened to this finding

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds from now to wake up. Clamped to [60, 3600] by the runtime. Required unless `stop` is true.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay. Goes to telemetry and is shown to the user. Be specific. Required unless `stop` is true.

prompt.description: The /loop input to fire on wake-up. Pass the same /loop input verbatim each turn so the next firing re-enters the skill and continues the loop. For autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` instead (the dynamic-pacing variant, not the CronCreate-mode `<<autonomous-loop>>`). Required unless `stop` is true.

stop.description: Set to true to end the dynamic loop immediately instead of scheduling another wakeup. When true, all other fields are ignored and no further wakeups fire.

noop.description: true = nothing changed (you checked and there is nothing to report). false = something happened worth keeping (edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, surfaced a finding). Consecutive noop:true ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak. Required unless `stop` is true.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

skill.description: The name of a skill from the available-skills list. Do not guess names.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

query.description: Query to find deferred tools. Use "select:<tool_name>" for direct selection, or keywords to search.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. Completed agent() calls with unchanged (prompt, opts) return their cached results instantly; only edited or new calls re-run. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

tools.name: DeferredToolPlaceholder
tools.description: Reserved placeholder that keeps deferred tool loading active; never call this tool.

tools.name: Write
tools.description:
Writes a file to the local filesystem, overwriting if one exists.

When to use: creating a new file, or fully replacing one you've already Read. Overwriting an existing file you haven't Read will fail. For partial changes, use Edit instead.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to write (must be absolute, not relative)

content.description: The content to write to the file

You have a persistent file-based memory at `/tmp/agent-config-vujx3tso/projects/-home-runner-work-codeReader-codeReader-work-aria2-aria2/memory/`. This directory already exists — write to it directly with the Write tool (do not run mkdir or check for its existence). Each memory is one file holding one fact, with frontmatter:

```markdown
name: <short-kebab-case-slug>
description: <one-line summary, used to decide relevance during recall>
```

This is ambient context — do not narrate it to the user unless they ask or it is directly relevant to their request.

# 项目学习手册·大纲规划 Planner

## 角色

你是资深技术教育专家、源码阅读导师和项目学习路线设计者。

你运行在被分析项目的根目录内。

你可以使用：

- `Read`
- `Grep`
- `Glob`
- 只读 `git` 命令，例如 `git log`、`git diff`、`git show`、`git ls-files`

你不能：

- 修改源码
- 写入任何 `.md` 文件
- 输出 JSON 以外的文字

你的唯一产出是一个学习手册大纲 manifest JSON。

---

## 总目标

为当前项目规划一套「从零开始、由浅入深、结合源码和代码实践」的学习手册。

这套手册会被拆分成多篇 Markdown 讲义，后续 worker 会根据 manifest 逐篇生成。

每篇讲义应该满足：

1. 面向初学者也能读懂。
2. 只讲一个相对独立的主题。
3. 必须结合真实源码。
4. 必须包含一个可操作的代码实践任务。
5. 讲义之间有清晰依赖关系。

---

## 源码探查顺序

请按以下顺序理解项目，不要一开始就深入细节：

1. 项目说明
   - README
   - docs
   - examples
   - tutorials

2. 构建与运行方式
   - package.json
   - Cargo.toml
   - pyproject.toml
   - go.mod
   - pom.xml
   - Makefile
   - Dockerfile
   - CI 配置

3. 项目入口
   - CLI 入口
   - Web 服务入口
   - main 文件
   - library export 文件
   - examples 入口

4. 目录结构
   - src
   - lib
   - app
   - packages
   - crates
   - tests

5. 核心流程
   - 初始化流程
   - 配置加载
   - 请求/任务/数据处理主链路
   - 插件、扩展、调度、存储等核心机制

6. 测试与示例
   - 单元测试
   - 集成测试
   - benchmark
   - example usage

---

## 学习路线设计原则

请把学习手册设计成三层：

1. 入门层 beginner
   目标：让读者知道项目是什么、怎么运行、目录如何组织、核心入口在哪里。

2. 进阶层 intermediate
   目标：让读者理解主要模块、核心调用链、关键数据结构和配置机制。

3. 专家层 advanced
   目标：让读者理解扩展点、性能、并发、错误处理、测试、二次开发和架构取舍。

---

## 讲义拆分规则

- 每篇讲义只解决一个主要问题。
- 每篇讲义包含 2 到 5 个最小模块。
- 每篇讲义必须有一个 `practice_task`，描述读者要完成的代码实践。
- 每篇讲义的源码范围要适中，通常引用 1 到 6 个关键源码文件。
- 大型项目可以拆成 30 篇以上讲义；中型项目 15 到 30 篇；小型项目 8 到 15 篇。
- 不要为了数量硬拆，逻辑优先。
- 第一单元必须帮助读者从零开始，包括项目定位、运行方式、目录结构、入口文件。
- 后续单元再进入核心模块、源码机制、扩展实践。

---

## mode=full

首次生成大纲时：

1. 阅读项目关键文件。
2. 理解项目定位、技术栈、运行方式和核心模块。
3. 设计从零开始的学习路径。
4. 输出完整 manifest。
5. 所有讲义的 `action` 都必须是 `"new"`。

---

## mode=incremental

增量更新时：

1. 读取 stdin 中提供的现有 manifest。
2. 阅读项目中已有的 `<项目名>-tutorial/` 讲义目录，理解旧结构。
3. 使用：

   - `git diff previous_head..current_head`
   - `git log`
   - `git show`

   分析代码变化。

4. 输出更新后的完整 manifest。

每篇讲义的 `action` 按以下规则设置：

- `"keep"`
  代码变化不影响这篇讲义，无需重写。

- `"update"`
  小范围改动，例如函数重命名、参数调整、局部逻辑变化、链接行号变化。

- `"new"`
  新增功能、新增模块、新增重要机制，需要新增讲义。

- `"rebuild"`
  架构、主流程、公共接口、核心模型发生重大变化，旧讲义需要重建。

如果某篇旧讲义已经不再适合当前项目结构，可以从 manifest 中移除。

## manifest 输出格式

只输出严格 JSON，不要输出 Markdown，不要输出解释文字。

```json
{
  "project": "<项目名>",
  "head": "<current_head>",
  "rationale": "中文说明：为什么这样设计学习顺序、单元划分和讲义顺序。",
  "units": [
    {
      "id": "u1",
      "title": "单元标题",
      "level": "beginner",
      "order": 1,

```

---

## 字段要求

- `project`：项目名。
- `head`：当前 git HEAD。
- `rationale`：中文，一段即可。
- `unit.id`：格式为 `u1`、`u2`、`u3`。
- `lecture.id`：格式为 `u1-l1`、`u1-l2`。
- `filename`：
  - 必须全局唯一。
  - 必须小写。
  - 使用连字符。
  - 必须以 `.md` 结尾。
  - 文件位于 `<项目名>-tutorial/` 目录下。
- `level`：
  - `"beginner"`
  - `"intermediate"`
  - `"advanced"`
- `source_files`：
  - 只能填写你实际读过或确认存在的源码文件。
  - 不要编造文件路径。
- `depends_on`：
  - 使用讲义 id。
  - 没有依赖时填写空数组。
- `action`：
  - full 模式全部为 `"new"`。
  - incremental 模式使用 `"keep"`、`"update"`、`"new"`、`"rebuild"`。

- 只基于真实源码和项目文件规划。
- 不确定的地方写 `"待确认"`。
- 不要编造不存在的模块、命令、接口或源码文件。
- 输出必须是合法 JSON。

### u1-l1 项目总览：aria2 是什么、能做什么

本讲是整套手册开篇，通过精读 README 特性清单、configure.ac、src/main.cc 与 FeatureConfig.cc 等文档型源码建立项目全貌。核心结论：aria2 是支持 HTTP(S)/FTP/SFTP/BitTorrent/Metalink 五类协议的命令行下载工具，核心卖点是「多源多协议并行下载」，且 HTTP 下载的数据会回哺 BT 网络。五类协议分两层：四个传输协议加一个元数据格式 Metalink（XML 镜像与校验和描述）。src/ 约九百个文件按文件名前缀划分子系统（Bt*、DHT*、Http* 等），协议差异被隔离在各协议的命令链层。功能与第三方库一一绑定：configure 探测库→定义编译宏→条件编译→--version 的 Features 行上报，故不同机器编译出的 aria2 特性集不同。本讲引入的关键术语：分段下载、DHT、RPC 控制面、编译期开关、Happy Eyeballs、命令链。版本号规则为 MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH，每月 15 日发版、5 日冻结，当前为 1.37.0。
### u1-l2 构建系统与依赖：从 configure.ac 到可执行文件

本讲围绕四个最小模块拆解 aria2 的构建系统：一、autotools 流水线，git 源码须先 `autoreconf -i` 生成 configure，再经 `./configure`、`make` 产出 `aria2c`；二、configure.ac 特性探测，`ARIA2_ARG_WITH` 默认不用、`ARIA2_ARG_WITHOUT` 默认探测，显式要求缺库即 `ARIA2_DEP_NOT_MET` 硬失败，且存在优先级（libxml2 优先 expat，TLS 后端与消息摘要后端按序择一）及特性推导（Metalink、异步 DNS 等）；三、src/Makefile.am 以公共 `SRCS` 加数十个 `if` 条件块拼装编译清单，所有源码先进 `libaria2.la`，`aria2c` 仅为 main.cc 加此库，探测结果经 `AC_DEFINE`（config.h 宏）、`AM_CONDITIONAL`（条件块）、`AC_SUBST`（@VAR@ 参数）三条通道生效，最终由 FeatureConfig.cc 上报为 `--version` 的 Features 行；四、build_test.sh 验证 15 种特性组合，Dockerfile.mingw 加 mingw-config 以全静态方式交叉编译 Windows 二进制。核心结论：一份源码可任意裁剪，不同配置产出特性集不同的二进制，configure 汇总表与版本输出同源可互证。
### u1-l3 进程入口：main.cc 与启动流程

本讲剖析 aria2 的启动链路：`::main` → `Platform` 构造 → `Context` 构造 → `reqinfo->execute()` → `Platform` 析构，止步于下载主循环之前。核心结论：aria2 有两个 main——全局 `::main` 只管进程级事务（控制台初始化、以 RAII 栈对象 `Platform` 圈定第三方库初始化与清理的生命周期、捕获 `aria2::Exception` 转为退出码），命名空间内的 `aria2::main` 管纯逻辑，供 standalone 命令行与 libaria2 库模式共用。`Platform` 以静态 `initialized_` 幂等地初始化 OpenSSL/GnuTLS/c-ares/libssh2 等，执行哪些分支由编译期 `#ifdef` 决定。`Context` 构造函数是总装车间，分七阶段把 argv 装配为 `reqinfo`（一个 `MultiUrlRequestInfo`）：选项解析、BT peer id、日志初始化、运行环境与 Socket 全局配置、按 torrent/metalink/input-file/URI 四级互斥分支创建 `RequestGroup`、清理一次性选项；`--version`/`--help`/`--show-files` 走提前退出，`reqinfo` 为空则不进主循环。`execute()` 固定三段骨架：`prepare()`（创建 `DownloadEngine` 并移交任务、装配 cookie/netrc/TLS/信号处理）→ `run()` → `getResult()`（结算退出码）。关键术语：RAII、standalone、`error_code` 枚举（FINISHED=0）、reqinfo、`RequestGroup`、`DownloadEngine`、`globalHaltRequested` 状态机（Ctrl-C 首按优雅停止、再按强制退出）。

### u1-l5 命令行选项系统：解析、校验与帮助文本

本讲剖析 aria2 命令行选项系统的五个模块：prefs.cc 登记选项键名并发放整数 ID（即 Pref），Option 以「ID 下标数组＋位图＋父链」三层结构存值，OptionHandler 家族以模板方法模式完成类型与取值范围校验，OptionParser 包装 getopt_long、先产出 NAME=VALUE 文本流再交处理器（使命令行、配置文件与 libaria2 嵌入调用共用同一条校验通道，剩余非选项参数即 URI 列表 nonopts），option_processing 以两遍解析完成总装并驱动帮助输出。核心结论：选项优先级「内置默认值＜配置文件＜环境变量＜命令行」由 Option 父子链查找实现，而非显式覆盖；Option 内部一切皆字符串，类型转换推迟到 getAsInt 等读取函数；非法值在入口被拦截并包装为错误码 28 的 OptionHandlerException；帮助文本没有独立文档源，是注册表按标签位过滤后的运行时投影。关键术语：Pref/PrefPtr、父链、OptionHandler、ARG_TYPE、nonopts、OPTION_ERROR。
### u2-l1 DownloadEngine：事件驱动主循环

本讲剖析 aria2 心脏 DownloadEngine::run() 的事件驱动主循环（Reactor 模式：单线程 I/O 多路复用，回调具体化为 Command 对象）。每圈三阶段：waitData 经事件轮询等 I/O；executeCommand 按状态过滤跑 commands_ 与 routineCommands_ 两条队列，任务命令平时仅执行 ACTIVE 状态，每秒一次全量刷新闸门唤醒 INACTIVE 睡眠者检查超时；afterEachIteration 消费 Ctrl-C 状态机实现两段式停机。两条队列同时排空即退出循环。核心约定：命令 execute() 返回 true 即销毁，返回 false 须已自我 requeue；超时命令抛 TIME_OUT，经 DlRetryEx 捕获后 prepareForRetry 重建 CreateRequestCommand 重试。DownloadEngineFactory 按选项装配引擎：事件后端由 --event-poll 与编译宏共同决定，AutoSave、TimedHalt 等周期命令随选项条件注册。
### u2-l2 EventPoll：I/O 多路复用的多后端抽象

本讲剖析 aria2 对 I/O 多路复用的多后端抽象 EventPoll：上层（DownloadEngine）只认 poll/addEvents/deleteEvents 三个契约与 EVENT_READ/WRITE/ERROR/HUP 四个事件位（源码中并无 A2_EVENT_NET_* 之名）。Event.h 提供与后端无关的回调骨架：SocketEntry 是 fd 上的 (Command, 事件位) 订阅表，CommandEvent 与 ADNSEvent（服务 c-ares 异步 DNS）负责分发，同一命令重复注册按位合并；抽象位与平台原语的互译靠注册方向的 translateEvents 和就绪方向的各后端 IEV_* 常量。四后端同形异神：epoll 持久注册、需维护用户态订阅镜像，kqueue 是过滤器模型（每 fd 读写各一条 kevent），port 为一次性注册、分发后须重新关联，select 每轮重建 fd_set 且受 FD_SETSIZE 上限约束；后端由 --event-poll 选项与编译宏共同选择，默认优先级 epoll>kqueue>port>libuv>poll>select，失败可退回 select。核心机制是事件回调「只置位不执行」：回调仅 setStatusActive 并置 IO 标志，真正执行延后到 executeCommand 按状态过滤统一进行；read_event_ 驱动数据搬运命令，write_event_ 驱动连接建立与发送命令。
### u2-l3 Command 体系：命令的生命周期与状态机

本讲剖析 aria2 的 Command 调度体系。Command 基类以 STATUS 状态位（INACTIVE/ACTIVE/REALTIME/ONESHOT_REALTIME）表达调度频率，以 read/write/error/hup 四个事件标志承接 EventPoll「只置位、不执行」的回调留言；statusMatch 按数值过滤，transitStatus 执行一次即降级 INACTIVE，防止忙等。核心所有权约定：execute() 返回 true 即销毁（清理都在析构），返回 false 必须已 addCommandSelf 重排。AbstractCommand::execute() 是模板方法骨架（终局检查→segment 刷新/换源→shouldProcess 分流→超时判定→executeInternal 协议钩子），三类异常出口决定去向：DlRetryEx 经 prepareForRetry 归还 segment、新建同 cuid 的 CreateRequestCommand 重试，DlAbortEx 走 tryReserved 换 URI，DownloadFailureException 整组停机。一次 HTTP 下载是 CreateRequest→Initiate(→Connect)→Request→Response→Download 四组命令接力，资源经构造参数传递，cuid 贯穿流水线。DownloadCommand 是「数据泵」，每轮读一块、经 StreamFilter 写盘、再自循环排队，靠 checkSocketRecvBuffer 升级实时状态实现零等待连续搬运；TimeBasedCommand 则是周期命令分支。

本讲从命令层上升到任务层，覆盖四个模块。核心结论：RequestGroup 是 aria2 对“一次下载任务”的容器抽象，聚合 Option、DownloadContext、SegmentMan、PieceStorage、URISelector 与 Dependency 等资源，以 `-s`（numConcurrentCommand_）为并发命令预算——长度已知后流式命令数不超过 min(split, piece 数)；而 `-x`（每主机连接上限）不在 RequestGroup 层，是在 FileEntry 挑选 URI 时按主机在途计数强制执行。RequestGroupMan 用 IndexedList 维护等待/活动两级队列，fillRequestGroupFromReserver 按 `-j` 名额提升任务，靠 requestQueueCheck 脏标记加 FillRequestGroupCommand 例程命令实现按需调度；任务以 numCommand 归零为结束判据，完成后经 PostDownloadHandler 派生新任务插到等待队列头。URISelector 分 inorder/feedback/adaptive 三种策略，反馈数据沉淀于 ServerStatMan。跨任务两类机制：校验/预分配经 RequestGroupEntry 加 SequentialPicker“停车场”串行挂起，元数据任务依赖由 BtDependency 表达。关键术语：GID、belongsTo/followedBy/following 链、DownloadResult、STATE_WAITING/STATE_ACTIVE。

本讲解剖 Authorization 与 Cookie 两个请求头的来历。认证分两层抽象：AuthConfig 持有确定的用户名/密码（用户名为空即视为无认证），AuthResolver 按主机名决策来源，AuthConfigFactory 按协议编排「URI 内嵌 userinfo ＞ 命令行选项 ＞ netrc ＞ 匿名默认值」的优先级链并逐请求求值；netrc 由状态机解析、首条匹配生效，HTTP 侧屏蔽其 default 条目，--http-auth-challenge 开启后改为 401 被动应答并缓存凭证重试一次。Cookie 遵循 RFC 6265：match 四重判定 secure、过期、pathMatch 目录边界与 domainMatch/hostOnly 域匹配；CookieStorage 用反向域名标签树组织，criteriaFind 沿树下行收集、按路径深度与创建时间排序，每域上限 50 条，全局超 2000 域触发 LRU 淘汰。

本讲剖析 aria2 走 HTTP 代理的两种方式：GET 模式把请求行从 origin-form 改为绝对 URI，明文 http 与默认 ftp 采用，不新增任何命令；CONNECT 隧道先让代理打通到目标的裸 TCP 管道再跑原生协议，https/sftp 恒为隧道，http/ftp 可由 --proxy-method=tunnel 强制。代理地址按「协议专属选项优先于 --all-proxy」解析并受 --no-proxy（域名/CIDR）豁免，结果装入 proxyRequest，使 DNS 与 TCP 连接目标换成代理，且到代理这一跳恒为明文 HTTP。隧道由 AbstractProxyRequest/ResponseCommand 公共骨架建立：发 CONNECT、等 200，非 200 抛 EX_PROXY_CONNECTION_FAILED 走可重试出口；打通后经 getNextCommand 切回普通命令链——HTTP 侧为 HttpRequestCommand（TLS 在隧道内与目标握手），FTP/SFTP 侧为 Ftp/SftpNegotiationCommand，ConnectCommand 依 ControlChain 决定入口。代理认证头 Proxy-Authorization（凭证内嵌于代理 URI）与目标认证的 Authorization 独立并存，日志中均被脱敏为 <snip>。
### u4-l5 FTP 与 SFTP：两套文件传输命令链

本讲剖析 aria2 的 FTP 与 SFTP 两条下载命令链。核心结论：FtpConnection 是 FTP 协议编解码器，负责命令拼装、应答码解析与粘包处理；FtpNegotiationCommand 是协议状态机，用 30 余个 Seq 状态驱动「USER/PASS/TYPE/PWD/CWD/SIZE/PASV/REST/RETR」完整协商，主动模式（PORT/EPRT）与被动模式（PASV/EPSV）的分歧只在数据连接由谁发起；数据泵复用 HTTP 链的 DownloadCommand，数据收满后仍需 FtpFinishDownloadCommand 等控制连接的 226 才回池。SFTP 是独立二进制协议而非「FTP over SSH」，其命令链是 FTP 链的同构压缩：握手、认证、open、fstat、seek 六步全在一条 SSH 连接内完成，断点续传用句柄 seek 替代 REST，全程遵循 libssh2 非阻塞 EAGAIN 三值约定。关键术语：控制/数据双通道、Seq 状态机、主机密钥指纹选项 ssh-host-key-md、连接池按用户名复用、SFTP 数据泵的写检查补偿。
### u4-l6 流式过滤：chunked 解码与 gzip 解压

本讲讲响应体写盘前的流式解码层，承接命令链与报文解析两讲。核心模块与结论：一是 StreamFilter 接口，以 delegate 委托链组合过滤器，transform() 返回值（写盘字节数）与 getBytesProcessed()（消费的输入字节数）是两个必须分开的计数；二是 ChunkedDecodingStreamFilter，用逐字节状态机解析 chunked，解析进度全部外置于成员变量，因此天然免疫 TCP 粘包与半包；三是过滤链装配：由响应头驱动，按 chunked 外层、gzip 内层、Sink 恒居链尾的顺序套接，DownloadCommand 读循环按 sinkFilterOnly_ 标志走两条路径，段完成判定额外要求整链 finished()；四是 GZipDecodingStreamFilter 封装 libz 流式解压，代价是禁用分段下载与文件预分配，故 aria2 默认不请求压缩。失败策略上，Transfer-Encoding 不支持即报错，Content-Encoding 不支持则降级为原样保存。
### u5-l1 DiskWriter 抽象：文件写入的统一接口

本讲剖析 aria2 文件写入层。DiskWriter 继承 BinaryStream（按偏移读写，支撑多连接并发写同一文件），定义三种打开方式：initAndOpenFile 截断新建、openExistingFile 只开已有、openFile 折中回退，另有只读、mmap 等默认为空的可选能力。骨架实现 AbstractDiskWriter 持有 fd 并以 RAII 兜底关闭；定位写为 seek 加循环 write，防部分写入；磁盘满抛致命异常立即停机，其他 I/O 错误走可重试出口；mmap 失败自动降级回 fd 路径。DiskWriterFactory 体系实现「注入工厂即改变下载目的地」：默认写磁盘，magnet 元数据等单文件任务注入内存型写入器（ByteArrayDiskWriter、BencodeDiskWriter），多文件任务由 MultiDiskAdaptor 逐文件自建写入器。重名文件时，auto-file-renaming 在创建写入器前改名，allow-overwrite 由 O_TRUNC 兑现覆盖，两者均禁则报 FILE_ALREADY_EXISTS 退出。
### u5-l2 PieceStorage：piece 级别的数据管理

本讲承接 u3-l4 的 SegmentMan 分段调度，下潜到存储层，覆盖五个模块：PieceStorage 抽象接口、BitfieldMan 位图运算器、Piece 运行时对象、DefaultPieceStorage 与 UnknownLengthPieceStorage 两套实现。核心结论：总字节流按 piece 切分，piece 内再按 16KB block 记账；BitfieldMan 以完成/在用/过滤三张位图的按位运算回答所有找块查询，稀疏策略取最长缺失区间、邻块在用则取中点，inorder 受 minSplitSize 约束；Piece 对象只为在途 piece 存活，完成即销毁、状态只留全局位图一个 bit；HTTP 与 BT 的领取（getMissingPiece）与归还（completePiece/cancelPiece）殊途同归同一记账出口，进度统计需累加在途进度；--select-file 落为过滤位图，横跨文件边界的 piece 会连带下载邻文件数据；长度未知时退化为单个生长 piece、仅单连接，BT 接口直接 abort。关键术语：在途 piece、end-game、PiecedSegment/GrowSegment、RarestPieceSelector、downloadFinished（认过滤）与 allDownloadFinished（须全满）之别、initStorage 创建 DiskAdaptor、markPiecesDone 断点恢复。
### u5-l3 DiskAdaptor：单文件与多文件布局适配

本讲讲解 PieceStorage 与 DiskWriter 之间的适配层 DiskAdaptor：它以 BinaryStream 契约向上暴露连续的逻辑偏移空间（全局偏移 goff），向下翻译为物理文件布局。单文件任务由 DefaultPieceStorage::initStorage 按 FileEntry 条目数选用 DirectDiskAdaptor（骨架 AbstractSingleDiskAdaptor，读写零翻译直通）；多文件任务用 MultiDiskAdaptor，写入时二分定位起始文件、按文件尾截长、懒打开并循环切分跨文件数据。核心矛盾是 piece 边界与文件边界不对齐：--select-file 时 resetDiskWriterEntries 以正反两趟扫描判定未选中邻居是否与选中文件共享首尾 piece，据 needsDiskWriter/needsFileAllocation 标志决定其获得写入器（必要时分配）或完全不落盘，零长文件例外总会被创建。全局共享的 OpenedFileCounter 把打开文件数控制在 100 以内，超限随机关闭回收。关键术语：DiskWriterEntry、FileEntry 的 requested 标志、cutTrailingGarbage、fileAllocationIterator。
### u5-l4 文件预分配：从 truncate 到 fallocate

本讲剖析 aria2 文件预分配阶段：校验结束后由 CheckIntegrityEntry 的 proceedFileAllocation 按三条件闸门（选项非 none、总长达 --no-file-allocation-limit 阈值、分配迭代器未完成）决定任务进入 FileAllocationMan 停车场（即 SequentialPicker 类型别名）还是跳过直奔下载。停车场单槽保证全局同一时刻只有一个任务在分配：常驻 dispatcher 每轮取队首铸造瞬时 worker，worker（RealtimeCommand）循环推进 allocateChunk，完成后调 prepareForNextAction 生成下载命令并析构放行下一任务。三种分配手段：trunc 用 ftruncate 生成稀疏文件，仅占位不占块；falloc 用 fallocate 真实占块；默认 prealloc 内部名 adaptive，先 4KB 试探、不支持则回退 256KB 写零。多文件任务由 MultiFileAllocationIterator 逐文件套用。关键术语：稀疏文件、预分配闸门、dispatcher/worker 模式、FileAllocationIterator、单槽串行化。
### u5-l5 校验与哈希：MessageDigest 与分块校验

本讲是磁盘 I/O 单元收尾，讲解 aria2 数据完整性校验体系，覆盖四个模块：一是校验数据载体，Checksum（整文件摘要，来自 --checksum 与 Metalink）与 ChunkChecksum（分块哈希表，来自 .torrent），经解析沉淀到 DownloadContext 的四个字段，由 isChecksumVerificationAvailable 等三个判定函数把关；二是 MessageDigest 门面，用 pImpl 加静态注册表统一 OpenSSL、libgcrypt、libnettle、Apple、内置五套哈希后端，后端在编译期择一链接，运行期仅查表；三是 IteratableValidator 可迭代校验契约（init、循环 validateChunk、finished），由 CheckIntegrityCommand 每轮推进小步以免阻塞事件循环，CheckIntegrityMan（SequentialPicker 单槽停车场）保证全局串行校验，入口由 RequestGroup 的四分支与三条件闸门选择；四是两个校验器对比：整文件校验器失败即清零 PieceStorage 位图，是否全量重下由 redownload_ 标志决定（普通下载失败仅报 CHECKSUM_ERROR=32）；分块校验器逐 piece 比对、本地位图攒齐后一次性写回，文件短缺块清位跳过，配合 --check-integrity 与 -c 实现断点续传只重下坏块。
### u5-l6 写盘缓存：WrDiskCache 的块管理

本讲剖析 `--disk-cache` 写盘缓存的完整实现链条：`RequestGroupMan` 持有进程唯一的 `WrDiskCache`（设 0 时根本不创建对象，全链路以空指针退化为直写），每个在途 piece 挂一个 `WrDiskCacheEntry`，数据以按全局偏移 goff 升序的 `DataCell` 集合组织，尾部连续可原地追加，HTTP 路径预留至少 4KiB 余量吸收小数据。核心结论：容量淘汰策略是「缓存字节最大者优先、并列取最久未更新（逻辑时钟）」，`std::set` 键不可变逼出 update 的「erase→改键→insert」舞步；flush 共五个时机——容量超限、piece/segment 完成、segment 换手防 BT 交叠写、自动保存前保位图一致（保留条目）、收尾关文件（释放条目）；cell 级与 piece 级双重排序使写出按文件偏移有序。写盘失败被记错误码后由调用方「清块＋抛错」，piece 重下、哈希兜底；`getDigestWithWrCache` 实现校验免回读。代价是 BT 每块与 HTTP 小数据各引入一次额外拷贝。
### u6-l1 torrent 元数据解析：bencode 与种子结构

本讲拆解 .torrent 文件如何被解析成下载任务。bencode 只有字符串、整数、列表、字典四种类型；bencode2 提供 decode（字节流转成 ValueBase 树）与 encode 两条门面链路。infohash 定义为 info 字典重编码后的 SHA-1，Dict 基于 std::map 键天然有序，保证重编码与原文截取一致，原文另存为 metadata 供 magnet 分发。bittorrent_helper 的各 load 入口殊途同归于 processRootDictionary：校验根字典、按 20 字节切分 pieces、装配 FileEntry（含目录穿越防护与 piece 数一致性检查）、读 announce/nodes。产物分流：文件列表与分块哈希进 DownloadContext 公共字段，infohash、tracker 层级等 BT 专属信息挂入 TorrentAttribute 属性槽；magnet 仅产出含 infohash/name/announceList 的极简属性，处于元数据获取模式。AnnounceList 是解析快照之上的运行期游标机：tier 内互为备份、失败降层、成功者提至队首并归位第一层，AnnounceTier 的 event 状态机决定 announce 事件参数与 stopped/completed 发送资格。
### u6-l2 BtRegistry 与 BtSetup：BT 运行时的装配

本讲剖析 BT 运行时的装配，核心模块为 BtRegistry、RequestGroup::createInitialCommand 的 BT 分支与 BtSetup。BtRegistry 是 DownloadEngine 拥有的注册表，以 GID 为键存放 BtObject「六件套」（DownloadContext、PieceStorage、PeerStorage、BtAnnounce、BtRuntime、BtProgressInfoFile），并托管 TCP/UDP 端口、LPD 接收器、UDP Tracker 客户端四个进程级槽位；按 infohash 查找是线性扫描，供被动握手、LPD、DHT 按内容反查任务。核心结论：六件套并非 BtSetup 创建，而是在 createInitialCommand 中装配并注册；任务经校验、预分配两个停车场后，由 BtFileAllocationEntry::prepareForNextAction 触发 BtSetup::setup，装配 TrackerWatcher、PeerChoke、ActivePeerConnection、SeedCheck 等种子级周期命令，并一次性完成端口绑定与 LPD 初始化，最后 setReady(true) 放行被动连接；magnet 模式裁剪部分装配。本讲还确立「进程级／种子级／peer 级」三层对象边界，peer 级对象不入注册表，并引入 bittorrent_helper 静态 peer id／peer agent 概念。

本讲剖析 aria2 与单个 peer 交互的两层分工：命令层 PeerInteractionCommand 是常驻自循环宿主，经状态机进入 WIRED 稳定态后，每 tick 驱动协议层的 DefaultBtInteractive::doInteractionProcessing()，固定顺序为：不活跃裁定→收干消息并分发→洪泛检测→choke/interest 决策（边沿触发，仅状态变化才发消息）→have 广播→keepalive→补请求流水线（深度从 6 翻倍至 256）→PEX→统一冲刷。keepalive（默认 120 秒）、洪泛检测（5 秒内 2 次即断连）、不活跃裁定（互不感兴趣 30 秒、无数据流动 60 秒、双 seeder）三个节律器均以 Timer 软节律实现。choke 决策与执行分离：PeerChokeCommand 每 10 秒在 PeerStorage 上全局重排，只写 chokingRequired_ 等标志。PeerStorage 以候选池、在用集、去重索引和 dropped 列表（供 PEX 广播）管理 peer，坏 peer 随机封禁 120~720 秒；ActivePeerConnectionCommand 周期性最多补 5 条出站连接，零连接时缩短 tracker announce 间隔自救。

本讲打开 BT 消息层黑盒。线上格式是「4 字节大端载荷长度＋载荷」的长度前缀分帧，长度 0 即 keepalive，由 PeerConnection 三态状态机读满长度字段时就地拦截，不进载荷阶段；超上限即断连。类层次为 BtMessage→AbstractBtMessage→SimpleBtMessage→ZeroBtMessage/RangeBtMessage→各具体消息，行为钩子是 onQueued、validate、doReceivedAction、send 及三个事件回调。三件套协作：Receiver 是零拷贝薄搬运工；Factory 是唯一「消息 id→类」映射点，经 setCommonProperty 统一注入七项依赖，未知 id 在此被拒；Dispatcher 管发送队列 messageQueue_ 与在途请求账本 requestSlots_（request 入队即记账，piece 到达按 index/begin/length 三元组对账核销），并执行上传限速与事件广播（choke、cancel、坏块重来时通知队列中消息自我作废或改发 reject）。request/piece 是数据面主角。关键术语：长度前缀分帧、keepalive、RequestSlot 账本、Fast Extension、事件广播、setCommonProperty。

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

# Metalink 解析：基于 SAX 的状态机

> 本讲属于第 8 单元「Metalink 与 RPC：服务化能力」，承接 u3-l3《任务创建流水线》中 `createRequestGroupForMetalink` 留下的悬念：一个 `.meta4` / `.metalink` 文件，究竟是如何变成 `MetalinkEntry` 列表的。

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应当能够：

1. 解释「推（push）式 SAX 回调 + 状态栈」这一解析架构：为什么 SAX 解析器不保存文档结构、aria2 如何用一个显式栈把元素嵌套还原出来。
2. 说出 `MetalinkParserStateMachine`、`MetalinkParserState` 家族、`MetalinkParserController` 三层的职责边界。
3. 对比 Metalink v3 与 v4 两套状态集的差异（命名空间、元素层级、优先级语义、错误处理）。
4. 解释 `XmlParser` 如何用同一个 `ParserStateMachine` 抽象接口同时适配 libxml2 和 Expat 两个 XML 后端。
5. 动手在解析链路上加日志，亲眼看到每个候选资源与校验和被收集的过程。

## 2. 前置知识

### 2.1 Metalink 回顾

在 u1-l1 我们提过：aria2 支持的「五类协议」中，Metalink 与其他四个不同——它不是传输协议，而是一种**元数据格式**，用一个 XML 文件描述「一个文件有哪些镜像、多校验和、分块哈希、签名」。下载时 aria2 从中挑出若干镜像源并行下载，并用其中的校验和保证数据完整性。

Metalink 有两个主要版本：

- **Metalink 3**（旧版，`http://www.metalinker.org/` 命名空间），元素层级较深：`metalink > files > file > verification > hash / pieces > hash`、`resources > url`。
- **Metalink 4**（RFC 5854，`urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:metalink` 命名空间），层级更扁平：`metalink > file > hash / pieces / url / metaurl`，并新增了 `metaurl`（可指向 torrent 或 magnet）。

注意一个常见误解：`--metalink-version` 选项**不是**用来指定「按 v3 还是 v4 格式解析」的——格式版本由 XML 根元素的命名空间 URI 自动判定；`--metalink-version` 是在解析**之后**按文件自己的 `<version>` 元素过滤条目（详见 4.4 节与 [src/Metalinker.cc:L47-L66](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/Metalinker.cc#L47-L66)）。

### 2.2 SAX：推模型的流式解析

解析 XML 有两大流派：

- **DOM（文档对象模型）**：一次性把整棵 XML 树读进内存，之后随意查询。内存开销与文档大小成正比。
- **SAX（Simple API for XML）**：解析器顺序扫描字节流，每遇到一个事件——元素开始、字符数据、元素结束——就**回调（callback）**你注册的函数。它不保存任何结构，内存占用恒定。

SAX 是「推模型」：不是你向解析器要数据，而是解析器把事件一个个推给你。你的代码必须自己记住「我现在在文档的哪个位置」，这就引出了状态机。

### 2.3 为什么需要状态机

SAX 回调是无状态的：`beginElement("hash")` 这个事件，既可能出现在 `file > hash`（整文件校验和），也可能出现在 `file > pieces > hash`（分块哈希）。仅凭事件名无法区分语义，必须知道「当前处于什么状态」。

aria2 的解法是经典的**状态模式（GoF State）**：

- 每个状态是一个对象，实现 `beginElement` / `endElement` 两个钩子；
- 状态机维护一个**状态栈**：遇到开始标签就压栈，遇到结束标签就弹栈——栈的内容恰好镜像了当前元素的嵌套路径；
- 栈顶状态决定「这个事件怎么解释、下一个状态是什么」。

### 2.4 事务（transaction）思想

解析过程中，一个 `<file>` 条目的各种信息（名字、大小、URL、校验和）是**陆续到达**的。`MetalinkParserController` 用「事务」组织这段收集过程：

- `newXxxTransaction()`：新建一个临时对象（如 `tEntry_`、`tResource_`）；
- 一串 `setXxxOf...()`：往临时对象里填字段；
- `commitXxxTransaction()`：把临时对象挂到父对象上；
- `cancelXxxTransaction()`：丢弃临时对象。

所有 `setXxx` 的第一行都是 `if (!tXxx_) return;`——遇到不合法或乱序的文档时，事务不存在，写入自然被忽略。这是一种以「空指针检查」实现的容错。

### 2.5 与前置讲义的衔接

u3-l3 讲过 `Context` 构造函数按 torrent / metalink / input-file / URI 四级互斥分支创建 `RequestGroup`。Metalink 分支的入口在 [src/Context.cc:L262-L269](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/Context.cc#L262-L269)：带 `--show-files` 时只解析并打印文件清单后退出；否则进入 `createRequestGroupForMetalink`。本讲就沿着这条线向下钻。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| [src/ParserStateMachine.h](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/ParserStateMachine.h) | 与具体 XML 库无关的抽象接口：任何「吃 SAX 事件的状态机」都实现它 |
| [src/MetalinkParserStateMachine.h](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/MetalinkParserStateMachine.h) / [.cc](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/MetalinkParserStateMachine.cc) | 状态机本体：状态栈、全部单例状态、通往 Controller 的全部转发方法 |

| [src/MetalinkParserStateImpl.cc](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/MetalinkParserStateImpl.cc) | 公共状态：`Initial`（版本分派）与 `SkipTag`（跳过未知子树），以及 `findAttr` 工具 |

整体调用链（自上而下）：

```
Context 构造（-M 分支）
  └─ createRequestGroupForMetalink            src/download_helper.cc

            └─ metalink::parseAndQuery        src/metalink_helper.cc
                 ├─ metalink::parseFile ──► MetalinkParserStateMachine（本讲主角）
                 │        └─ xml::parseFile   src/XmlParser.cc
                 │             └─ XmlParser（libxml2 或 Expat 适配，4.5 节）
                 │                  └─ SAX 回调 ──► psm->beginElement / endElement
                 │                        └─ 状态栈 + MetalinkParserController（4.1–4.4 节）
                 └─ Metalinker::queryEntry   （--metalink-version/language/os 过滤，u8-l2）
```

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 MetalinkParserStateMachine：状态栈驱动的解析骨架

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

`MetalinkParserStateMachine` 是解析的「总机」：它不认识任何具体元素，只做三件事——

1. **维护状态栈**：栈顶永远是「当前正在解析的元素」对应的状态。
2. **持有 `MetalinkParserController`**：状态对象不直接碰数据，一律通过状态机的几十个转发方法（`newEntryTransaction`、`setURLOfResource`……）间接调用 Controller。这层纯转发的间接性是刻意设计：状态类只依赖状态机接口，数据收集逻辑集中在一处。
3. **管理全部状态单例**：状态对象无字段、可复用，全局只 new 一次（享元 flyweight），永远不释放。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

两个入口方法的骨架（伪代码）：

```
beginElement(localname, prefix, nsUri, attrs):
    stateStack_.top()->beginElement(this, ...)   # 委派给栈顶状态
    # 状态在 beginElement 内部自行调用 psm->setXxxState() 压入新状态
    # （或 setSkipTagState() 压入"跳过"状态）

endElement(localname, prefix, nsUri, characters):
    stateStack_.top()->endElement(this, ..., characters)  # 先让栈顶消费文本
    stateStack_.pop()                            # 再弹栈
```

由此得到本模块最重要的**不变量**：

- 每个 `beginElement` 事件恰好压栈一次（具体状态或 SkipTag，二选一，检查每个状态的实现可验证所有分支都压栈）；
- 每个 `endElement` 事件恰好弹栈一次；
- 因此**栈深度 = 当前未闭合元素的嵌套深度 + 1**（栈底永远是 `initialState_`）；
- 栈回到只剩 `initialState_` 时，`finished()` 为真——不过 Metalink 场景下上层并不依赖它，文档是否完整由 XML 解析器自己保证。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

构造函数压入初始状态，栈由此开始生长：

- [src/MetalinkParserStateMachine.cc:L108-L112](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/MetalinkParserStateMachine.cc#L108-L112)：构造时创建 Controller 并把 `initialState_` 压栈。

全部 25 个状态在文件开头以静态成员指针一次性构造，V3 一组、V4 一组：

- [src/MetalinkParserStateMachine.cc:L49-L81](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/MetalinkParserStateMachine.cc#L49-L81)：`initialState_`、`skipTagState_` 与 Metalink 3 的 14 个状态单例（metalink / files / file / size / version / language / os / verification / hash / pieces / pieceHash / signature / resources / url）。
- [src/MetalinkParserStateMachine.cc:L83-L106](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/MetalinkParserStateMachine.cc#L83-L106)：Metalink 4 的 12 个状态单例（多出 `metaurlStateV4_`，没有 files / verification / resources 三个容器状态）。

压栈与弹栈的两个入口：

2. 执行：

3. `--show-files` 与 `-M` 组合时走 [src/Context.cc:L262-L265](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/Context.cc#L262-L265) 的提前退出分支，调用 `showMetalinkFile`（[src/Context.cc:L101-L109](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/Context.cc#L101-L109)），它内部就是 `metalink::parseAndQuery` + 打印。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `endElement` 里的 `pop()` 放在状态机而不是放在各状态的 `endElement` 实现里？

**参考答案**：弹栈是状态机的全局约定（对应 4.1.2 的不变量：一个结束标签必弹一次）。若交给几十个状态类各自实现，任何一个状态忘记弹栈或弹两次，栈就与元素嵌套脱钩且难以排查。集中在一处后，状态类只需表达「结束时提交什么数据」，结构性职责留在状态机。这也是模板方法思想：固定骨架（弹栈）在基类流程里，可变步骤（数据处理）留给子类。

**练习 2**：状态对象为什么可以做成全局单例、连解析结束都不销毁？

**参考答案**：`MetalinkParserState` 的接口（[src/MetalinkParserState.h:L48-L66](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/MetalinkParserState.h#L48-L66)）没有任何可写字段——所有中间数据都存在 Controller 的事务对象里，状态只携带行为。无状态对象天然线程安全、可共享，做成静态单例（[src/MetalinkParserStateMachine.cc:L49-L106](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/MetalinkParserStateMachine.cc#L49-L106)）省去了每次解析的分配开销。代价是「当前解析到第几个 file」这类信息必须外置在 Controller，这正是事务机制存在的原因之一。

**练习 3**：`reset()`（[src/MetalinkParserStateMachine.cc:L116-L124](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/MetalinkParserStateMachine.cc#L116-L124)）做了哪几件事？谁会调用它？

**参考答案**：三件事——重置 Controller（换一个全新 `Metalinker`）、清空错误列表、把状态栈清空后重新压入 `initialState_`。调用方是 XML 适配层的 `XmlParser::reset()`（libxml2 与 Expat 两版都有），用于把解析器对象复用于新一轮会话；命令行的一次性解析路径（`metalink::parseFile`）则直接新建状态机，不走 reset。

### 4.2 ParserState 家族（一）：Initial 版本分派、SkipTag 与 V3 状态链

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

`MetalinkParserState` 基类提供三个钩子（`beginElement` / `endElement` / `needsCharactersBuffering`），默认全部「什么都不做 / 不需要缓冲」。三个家族成员承担骨架角色：

- **InitialMetalinkParserState**：文档的第一枪。只处理根元素，用**命名空间 URI** 判定文档是 Metalink 3、Metalink 4 还是不认识的杂牌。
- **SkipTagMetalinkParserState**：万能垃圾桶。任何不认识的子树都切到它，它的 `beginElement` 继续压 SkipTag，从而整棵子树被无副作用地跳过。
- **V3 状态链**：与 Metalink 3 的元素层级一一对应。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

版本分派逻辑（伪代码）：

```
Initial.beginElement(localname, nsUri):
    if localname != "metalink" 或无命名空间:  → SkipTag（整份文档作废）
    elif nsUri == "urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:metalink":  → Metalink V4 根状态
    elif nsUri == "http://www.metalinker.org/":      → Metalink V3 根状态
    else:                                     → SkipTag
```

V3 的状态迁移图（元素层级 → 状态压栈）：

```
metalink          → MetalinkMetalinkParserState
 └ files          → FilesMetalinkParserState        （只是容器）
    └ file@name   → FileMetalinkParserState          + newEntryTransaction
       ├ size     → SizeMetalinkParserState          （文本 → 文件长度）
       ├ version  → VersionMetalinkParserState
       ├ language → LanguageMetalinkParserState
       ├ os       → OSMetalinkParserState
       ├ verification → VerificationMetalinkParserState（容器）
       │  ├ hash@type   → HashMetalinkParserState    + newChecksumTransaction
       │  ├ pieces@length@type → PiecesMetalinkParserState + newChunkChecksumTransaction
       │  │   └ hash@piece=序号 → PieceHashMetalinkParserState
       │  └ signature@type@file → SignatureMetalinkParserState + newSignatureTransaction
       └ resources   → ResourcesMetalinkParserState  （容器）
          └ url@type@location@preference@maxconnections
                         → URLMetalinkParserState     + newResourceTransaction
```

注意配对规律：**容器状态只有 `beginElement`**（把子元素分发出去），**叶子文本状态只有 `endElement`**（消费文本并提交事务），这正是 SAX 事件与元素性质的天然对应。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

版本分派的三岔口：

- [src/MetalinkParserStateImpl.cc:L74-L92](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/MetalinkParserStateImpl.cc#L74-L92)：`InitialMetalinkParserState::beginElement` 先看标签名必须是 `metalink`，再比较两个命名空间常量，命中 V4 或 V3 分别压对应根状态，否则进 SkipTag。两个常量定义在各自的实现文件里：V3 为 `http://www.metalinker.org/`（[src/MetalinkParserStateV3Impl.cc:L47](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/MetalinkParserStateV3Impl.cc#L47)），V4 为 `urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:metalink`（[src/MetalinkParserStateV4Impl.cc:L47](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/MetalinkParserStateV4Impl.cc#L47)）。

SkipTag 的自我延续：

- [src/MetalinkParserStateImpl.cc:L94-L101](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/MetalinkParserStateImpl.cc#L94-L101)：`SkipTagMetalinkParserState::beginElement` 无论遇到什么子元素都再压一个 SkipTag——未知子树的每一层都被吞掉，且 `needsCharactersBuffering` 用基类默认值 `false`，连文本都不缓冲。测试 [test/MetalinkProcessorTest.cc:L47](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/test/MetalinkProcessorTest.cc#L47) 的 `testXmlPrefixV3` 就验证了带前缀的未知元素不影响解析。

属性查找工具（全家族共用）：

- [src/MetalinkParserStateImpl.cc:L67-L72](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/MetalinkParserStateImpl.cc#L67-L72)：`findAttr(attrs, localname, nsUri)` 在属性表里线性查找；匹配条件是「名字相同，且属性自身无命名空间或命名空间相等」——这容忍了不同 XML 库对默认命名空间属性的表示差异。

V3 链条的几个关键状态：

- [src/MetalinkParserStateV3Impl.cc:L56-L66](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/MetalinkParserStateV3Impl.cc#L56-L66)：V3 根状态只认子元素 `files`，其余进 SkipTag（所以 `<published>` 之类的全局元素不会误入 `files` 之外的路径）。
- [src/MetalinkParserStateV3Impl.cc:L68-L89](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/MetalinkParserStateV3Impl.cc#L68-L89)：`files > file@name` 处开**条目事务**：先压 `FileState`，再取 `name` 属性；名字为空或检出目录穿越（`util::detectDirTraversal`，防 `../` 逃逸）时直接 `return`——注意此时状态已压栈，元素仍会被正常遍历，只是没有开事务，后续所有 `set` 落空，这个 file 条目最终不会被收集。真实攻击样例见 [test/metalink3-dirtraversal.xml:L4](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/test/metalink3-dirtraversal.xml#L4) 的 `name="../aria2-0.5.2.tar.bz2"`。
- [src/MetalinkParserStateV3Impl.cc:L91-L134](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/MetalinkParserStateV3Impl.cc#L91-L134)：`FileState::beginElement` 是 V3 的元素级路由器：`size` / `version` / `language` / `os` / `verification` / `resources` 各压对应状态；`resources` 还顺带读取 `maxconnections` 属性（解析失败或 ≤0 一律记 -1 表示未指定）。
- [src/MetalinkParserStateV3Impl.cc:L136-L142](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/MetalinkParserStateV3Impl.cc#L136-L142)：`</file>` 时提交条目事务——这是每个下载条目的收官点。
- [src/MetalinkParserStateV3Impl.cc:L144-L155](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/MetalinkParserStateV3Impl.cc#L144-L155)：V3 对坏 `<size>` 的态度是**静默忽略**（解析失败就不设长度），与 V4 的「取消条目并记错误」形成鲜明对比（见 4.3）。
- [src/MetalinkParserStateV3Impl.cc:L183-L251](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/MetalinkParserStateV3Impl.cc#L183-L251)：`verification` 路由三种完整性元素：`hash@type` 开校验和事务；`pieces@length@type` 开分块校验事务（缺任一属性直接 `return`，事务不开）；`signature@type` 开签名事务，还可带 `file` 属性（同样做目录穿越检查）。
- [src/MetalinkParserStateV3Impl.cc:L262-L307](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/MetalinkParserStateV3Impl.cc#L262-L307)：`pieces > hash@piece=序号`——V3 的每个分块哈希带**显式序号**；序号缺失或非法会 `cancelChunkChecksumTransaction()`，即整个分块校验事务作废（不只是丢这一块）。`</pieces>` 时提交（L290-L297），每个 `</hash>` 时填一块（L299-L307）。
- [src/MetalinkParserStateV3Impl.cc:L319-L392](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/MetalinkParserStateV3Impl.cc#L319-L392)：`resources > url` 的属性装配。三处值得注意：(1) `type` 属性**必填**，缺失直接放弃这个 URL；(2) `preference` 语义翻转——Metalink 3 规定 100 最高，而 aria2 内部统一用「1 最高」的 V4 优先级体系，因此 `preference = 101 - preference`（[L343-L360](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/MetalinkParserStateV3Impl.cc#L343-L360) 的注释写明了这层换算）；(3) `</url>` 时填 URL 文本并提交资源事务（L385-L392）。

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：一个 v3 文档的 `<file>` 缺少 `name` 属性，解析会发生什么？条目会进结果吗？

**参考答案**：[src/MetalinkParserStateV3Impl.cc:L74-L84](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/MetalinkParserStateV3Impl.cc#L74-L84) 中 `findAttr` 找不到 `name` 时 `itr == attrs.end()`，整段 if 跳过，`newEntryTransaction()` 不会被调用；`FileState` 仍压栈，其子元素照常解析，但 Controller 的 `tEntry_` 为空指针，所有 set 被空检查挡掉；`</file>` 的 `commitEntryTransaction` 同样因空指针直接返回。条目不会进入 `Metalinker`。V3 在这里选择静默丢弃（无 `logError`），V4 则会显式记错误（4.3 对比）。

**练习 2**：为什么 `FilesMetalinkParserState` 这类容器状态也要 `needsCharactersBuffering() = true`（[src/MetalinkParserStateV3Impl.h:L60](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/MetalinkParserStateV3Impl.h#L60)）？

**参考答案**：字符缓冲栈的检查时机是「元素开始之后、字符到来之前」，问的是**新压栈的状态**（见 4.5.3）。容器元素之间的空白、换行也是字符事件；容器状态开缓冲，保证字符栈的 push/pop 与元素栈严格同步，子元素的文本永远落在栈顶自己的格子里。反过来，SkipTag 关闭缓冲，被跳过子树的文本一律丢弃，节省内存。

**练习 3**：v3 的 `<url type="http">` 里 `type` 缺失会怎样？这和「type 写了不认识的值」有何不同？

**参考答案**：缺失时 [src/MetalinkParserStateV3Impl.cc:L330-L335](https://github.com/aria2/aria2/blob/9e7273583f83e881e3ec067b523ba88724088d2f/src/MetalinkParserStateV3Impl.cc#L330-L335) 直接 `return`，`newResourceTransaction` 都没执行，URL 文本最终无处安放，资源被丢弃。写了不认识的值（如 `type="gopher"`）则会开事务、URL 正常收集，但在 Controller 的 `setTypeOfResource`（4.4.3）里被标为 `TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED`，资源保留但下载阶段不会用它。一个是「结构性缺失、直接扔」，一个是「语义不识别、保留但降级」。

### 4.3 ParserState 家族（二）：V4 状态集与 V3/V4 差异

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

Metalink 4（RFC 5854）对格式做了扁平化改造，aria2 为它另起一套状态而不是在 V3 上打补丁——两套规范元素树不同，硬塞进一套状态类只会让分支爆炸。V4 状态集的共同风格是**显式报错**：凡违反规范的属性一律 `psm->logError(...)` 记录（部分场景还会取消整个条目），解析结束后由上层把这些违规汇总成异常（见 4.4.3）。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

V4 的状态迁移图：

```
metalink              → MetalinkMetalinkParserStateV4
 └ file@name          → FileMetalinkParserStateV4        + newEntryTransaction
    ├ size            → SizeMetalinkParserStateV4        （坏值 → 取消条目 + logError）
    ├ version         → VersionMetalinkParserStateV4
    ├ language        → LanguageMetalinkParserStateV4
    ├ os              → OSMetalinkParserStateV4
    ├ hash@type       → HashMetalinkParserStateV4        + newChecksumTransaction
    ├ pieces@length@type → PiecesMetalinkParserStateV4   + newChunkChecksumTransactionV4
    │   └ hash        → PieceHashMetalinkParserStateV4   （按文档顺序追加）
    ├ url@location@priority → URLMetalinkParserStateV4   + newResourceTransaction
    ├ metaurl@mediatype@priority@name → MetaurlMetalinkParserStateV4 + newMetaurlTransaction
    └ signature@mediatype → SignatureMetalinkParserStateV4 + newSignatureTransaction
```

V3 与 V4 的关键差异汇总：

| 维度 | Metalink 3 | Metalink 4 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 命名空间 URI | `http://www.metalinker.org/` | `urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:metalink` |
| 条目容器 | `files > file`（两级） | `file` 直接挂在根下（一级） |
| 完整性容器 | `verification` 包住 hash/pieces/signature | 无容器，三者平级挂在 `file` 下 |
| URL 容器 | `resources > url` | `url` 平级 |
| URL 类型 | `url@type` 必填 | 无 type，从 URL scheme 推断（4.4.3） |
| 优先级 | `@preference`，100 最高，内部换算 `101-preference` | `@priority`，1 最高，直接用 |
| 分块哈希序号 | 每个 `hash@piece=序号` 显式给出，提交时按序号排序 | 无序号，按**文档出现顺序**追加 |
| 种子资源 | `url@type="bittorrent"`（或 torrent），事后转成 metaurl | 专门的 `metaurl@mediatype="torrent"` 元素 |
| 坏 `<size>` | 静默忽略 | 取消整个条目 + `logError("Bad size")` |
| 违规处理 | 多数静默跳过 | `logError` 记录（上限 10 条），汇总成异常 |
